_doc: Test tiers for CI. 'labels' are Django test labels. Nothing in a tier is ever skipped to get a green build; PostgreSQL/Redis-only tests are run in the tiers that provide those services. 'optional_labels' are included only when the module exists in the commit being tested (so the same tier definition works on commits before and after a feature landed). 'min_tests' is ~95% of the count measured on 2026-11-12 (fast 2052, security_pg 589, finance_pg 2287, tenant 5302): it catches a tier that silently lost its tests.

fast.protects: authentication, OTP, registration, CAPTCHA, production settings and system checks, rate limits, public site

security_pg.protects: OTP concurrency and cooldown on PostgreSQL, CAPTCHA against a real Redis, production boot with real Redis

finance_pg.protects: exactly-once payment fulfilment, refund policy, trial and subscription lifecycle, tenant isolation of orders, background jobs

tenant.protects: store scoping, tenant isolation, merchant dashboard, storefront content; blog and full storefront builder tests
